notes: This contract records a portable installed-package C++ TCK case for an ordinary Attribute Ownership Acquisition request denied by its current owner. The scenario uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador declarations plus the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider library, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the release-request and ownership-unavailable callback metadata and confirms ownership remains with the current owner after denial; it does not assert provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition and attributeOwnershipReleaseDenied with FederateAmbassador requestAttributeOwnershipRelease and attributeOwnershipUnavailable callbacks and isAttributeOwnedByFederate queries
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-management declarations
